title: Reports: Packers targeting Week 12 for Micah Parsons return

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Reports: Packers targeting Week 12 for Micah Parsons return
sources.description: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said this week that he hopes defensive end Micah Parsons starts practicing with the team next week and the team reportedly has a goal in mind for Parsons's return to game action.
